messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Zepbound and Mounjaro contain the same active ingredient, tirzepatide, and share the same inactive ingredients.
Active ingredient: tirzepatide
Inactive ingredients (single-dose pens and vials):
- Sodium chloride
- Sodium phosphate dibasic heptahydrate
- Water for injection
- Hydrochloric acid and/or sodium hydroxide (added to adjust pH)
Additional inactive ingredients (KwikPen and multi-dose vial only):
- Benzyl alcohol
- Glycerin
- Phenol
Triplet: ["Zepbound", "has additional inactive ingredient", "benzyl alcohol"]

The relation 'has additional inactive ingredient' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug contains an extra inactive substance specified by the object entity, beyond the standard inactive ingredients.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has inactive ingredient': The subject drug contains the inactive substance specified by the object entity.
B. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
C. 'has product variation': The subject drug has a different formulation or version specified by the object entity.
D. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
